ReferenceDate.name: Reference Date
ReferenceDate.definition: Date to which the target market data refers. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 01000.

InvestorType.name: Investor Type
InvestorType.definition: Investor for which the financial instrument is targeted.

KnowledgeAndOrExperience.name: Knowledge And Or Experience
KnowledgeAndOrExperience.definition: Knowledge and/or experience of the investor.
